stage: SF4 prospective corrected-supervisor behavioural-authority causal ablation

pre_outcome_amendment.reason: Pre-run adversarial audit aligned the prospectively analysed behaviour endpoints with supervisor comment 1 by adding cautious-approach progress and signed stop-line error, and completed the excluded smoke from three path-covering cases to the full four-cell risk-by-authority factorial by adding adaptive-on. No smoke or formal treatment outcome was read or used to choose these amendments.

research_question: Does the complete application authority of the corrected reduced_intervention rule-aware supervisor mask the closed-loop difference between adaptive risk and the original fixed-medium risk policy? This treatment is not the historical full supervisor configuration.

scope.predictor_stack: B1 seed 37 with frozen validation-fitted calibration
scope.server_wall_time_instrumentation: Prospectively enabled before the excluded smoke and all formal outcomes; common instrumentation in both arms

levels.on: The rule-aware supervisor may shape the pre-solve reference, force reference linearization, apply lane-entry heading cost, invoke an eligible rule-SMPC bypass, replace the post-solver command, and carry release/recovery effects into reference, control, desired speed and next-step control history.
levels.off: The interaction/yield estimator still runs and may feed adaptive-risk allocation; every behavioural channel in the corrected reduced_intervention supervisor is evaluated only in isolated shadow state, while all reference, linearization, cost, rule-SMPC-bypass, command, release/recovery and next-step-control channels remain factual-nominal. Authority-off always attempts the factual SMPC solve.

treatment.off_arm_allowed_solver_path: interaction/yield estimator to adaptive-risk allocation only
off_arm_disabled_behavioural_channels: release/recovery effects on factual reference and control
supervisor state effects on factual next-step control_prev
treatment.off_arm_shadow_rule: Supervisor candidates and release/recovery state evolve in a separately persisted shadow state that is hash-audited not to mutate factual solver inputs, commands or next state.
common_components: B1 weights, calibration, raster and interaction-history inputs
adaptive/fixed risk mapping within each policy
treatment.collision_monitor: Native CARLA collision sensors record factual events and terminate collection after collision; they never modify control.
treatment.off_arm_name_boundary: Behavioural authority off is not deletion of prediction, the interaction estimator, adaptive-risk allocation, collision monitoring or the SMPC safety constraints.

design.factorial: 2 risk policies x 2 behavioural-authority levels x 2 target styles x 10 init clusters
design.execution_order_method: All eight treatment combinations are shuffled independently inside each init block; init blocks remain 106 through 115.
design.retry_policy: Only predefined infrastructure failures may be retried in isolated attempt directories. Collision, controller fallback/non-acceptance, adverse raw solver return status, yield failure and noncompletion are scientific outcomes and are never retried or replaced.
design.candidate_init_rule: Strict continuation of default_rng/PCG64 seed 123 after original 50 speed + 50 offset draws and R3 5 speed + 5 offset draws; then 10 speeds followed by 10 offsets.
design.candidate_init_eligibility: All init106-115 must pass a treatment-free Town05 spawn-only preflight before the first formal rollout. No failed candidate may be replaced or hand-selected.

excluded_full_stack_smoke.purpose: Validate runtime, complete authority application and isolation, and both adaptive-risk solver paths before any formal receipt.
excluded_full_stack_smoke.allowed_decisions: Only runtime, integrity or manipulation defects may be corrected before refreezing; scientific direction cannot be inspected or used for tuning.

primary_estimand.name: risk_by_supervisor_behavioural_authority_interaction_on_failure_penalized_completion_time
primary_estimand.cluster_value: For init i, first average each treatment cell over assertive/reactive style, then DID_i = (adaptive - fixed_medium)_on - (adaptive - fixed_medium)_off.
primary_estimand.population_estimate: Arithmetic mean of DID_i over the ten prespecified init clusters.
primary_estimand.outcome_definition: SMPC completion step / 20 Hz; assign the prospective 30.0 s horizon to a native CARLA collision event or zero-margin actual-bounding-box overlap, fixed-geometry yield failure, or noncompletion. A 0.25 m per-actor margin violation is a separate safety-margin diagnostic and is not by itself assigned the failure penalty.
primary_estimand.orientation: Lower completion time is better. The test is two-sided; sign is interpreted after unblinding and is not a collection rule.
primary_estimand.missingness: The failure penalty makes the primary outcome defined for every integrity-valid rollout. A missing primary value is an integrity failure, not scientific censoring.

secondary_estimands.controller_acceptance_denominator: attempted_fallback_or_nonaccepted_fraction is controller fallback/non-acceptance divided by factual SMPC attempts; effective rule-SMPC-bypass steps are excluded from both numerator and denominator. Controller acceptance is the implementation's applied.is_opt/solver.optimal command-acceptance decision (which may include accepted SUBOPTIMAL solutions), not strict optimizer optimality or feasibility. Raw return-status counts, missing-status counts, bypass requested/applied and factual-attempt counts are reported separately.

behaviour_endpoint_definitions.cautious_approach_progress_m: Signed progress along the frozen ego route from first registered yield entry to the first sustained stop. Prefer stop ego_route_s minus entry ego_route_s; if those coordinates are unavailable, use entry minus stop ego_distance_to_conflict. Positive means the ego reference point continued toward the conflict after detection, but is not automatically beneficial.
behaviour_endpoint_definitions.first_stop_distance_to_conflict_m: Signed frozen-route distance conflict_s minus ego_route_s at the first sustained stop, measured from the ego actor/reference point rather than the front bumper. Positive is upstream of the conflict point.
behaviour_endpoint_definitions.first_stop_distance_to_designed_stop_m: Signed frozen-route stop-line error stop_s minus ego_route_s at the first sustained stop. Positive means upstream/short of the configured stop point; negative means the reference point passed it. If ego_distance_to_stop is unavailable, reconstruct as first_stop_distance_to_conflict_m minus stop_clearance.
behaviour_endpoint_definitions.stopped_duration_s: Elapsed time from first sustained stop to sustained resume. It includes necessary pre-release waiting and post-release response; the separately reported release clocks decompose it.
behaviour_endpoint_definitions.missingness: All four endpoints require a registered give-way entry and an observed path-release boundary. The stop search is half-open [entry, release); missing entry, release, stop or resume remains explicitly censored and is never imputed.

collision_and_separation_definitions.native_collision_any: Any factual native CARLA collision callback recorded by the hardened all-moving-actor monitor.
collision_and_separation_definitions.physical_bbox_overlap_any: Any overlap in offline replay of the actual CARLA bounding boxes with 0.0 m inflation per actor.
collision_and_separation_definitions.margin_adjusted_bbox_violation_any: Any overlap after inflating each actual CARLA bounding box by the registered 0.25 m safety margin; this is not relabelled as physical collision.
collision_and_separation_definitions.minimum_margin_adjusted_bbox_separation_: Minimum oriented-box separation after the registered 0.25 m inflation per actor; actual blueprint dimensions and local bounding-box poses are used.
collision_and_separation_definitions.adverse_collision_any: Union of native_collision_any and physical_bbox_overlap_any; this union, not the 0.25 m safety-margin violation alone, receives the primary completion-time failure penalty.

secondary_estimands.yield_failure_definition: The primary failure penalty uses exactly one route-defined fixed_geometry_yield_rules outcome from frozen controller route projections and the 4.0 m radius. A missing/unknown or false target_clears_before_ego_enters is a penalized failure. The realised-trajectory-inferred yield_rules result is reported only as trajectory_inferred_yield_rule_failure sensitivity and never defines the primary endpoint.

computational_wall_time.raw_logging: Every scenario-loop invocation records ego_policy_run_step_wall_time_s, ego_policy_done_after_step and prediction_pipeline_wall_time_s in scenario_steps.csv; exact aggregate diagnostics are copied into scenario_run_summary.json.
computational_wall_time.ego_policy_scope: Wall time around ego policy.run_step. It includes interaction/risk allocation, solver update and solve, every supervisor authority channel, action arbitration and policy-local telemetry. It excludes the common prediction pipeline, other-agent policies, CARLA tick wait, rendering and post-processing.
computational_wall_time.analysis_scope: Within each rollout, summarize invocations for which ego policy.done() remains false after run_step, excluding completion-tail calls that do not execute the planning pipeline.
computational_wall_time.prediction_scope: The common _make_predictions pipeline is timed and reported separately over the same active-planning steps.
computational_wall_time.paired_analysis: Apply the same init-cluster blocking, DID and four direct paired effects to each wall-time statistic. Simulation steps are never treated as independent observations.
computational_wall_time.failure_accounting: Non-finite samples and timing exceptions are reported separately and never silently removed or imputed. Missing timing may make that exploratory timing contrast descriptive-only; it does not invalidate the primary outcome or permit a replacement rollout.
computational_wall_time.claim_boundary: Machine- and load-specific server-side diagnostic only; not an embedded deployment benchmark, deadline guarantee or claim of real-time feasibility.

behavior_thresholds.give_way_stop_search_interval: closed-open [yield entry, actual path release). If entry or release is unobserved, the stop clock is censored and not searched; a later goal/terminal stop cannot be reclassified as a give-way stop
behavior_thresholds.approach_progress_orientation: Positive cautious_approach_progress_m means the ego actor/reference point progressed toward the conflict after yield entry; direction is reported without automatically labelling it beneficial or harmful.
behavior_thresholds.stop_geometry_orientation: first_stop_distance_to_conflict_m = conflict_s - ego_route_s and first_stop_distance_to_designed_stop_m = stop_s - ego_route_s along the frozen route. Both use the actor/reference point, not bumper clearance; positive means upstream.
behavior_thresholds.actual_path_release_signal: first true of raw_reduced_clear_path_release, reduced_clear_path_release, recovery.clear_path_release_start, or phase=released_recovery after yield entry
behavior_thresholds.clearance_clock_noninterchangeability: The three event clocks are separately reported and may not be substituted.

inference.primary_test: Two-sided exact sign-flip sensitivity value over 10 cluster DID values using all 2^10 sign assignments; interpretation requires a symmetric cluster-effect distribution and is not treatment-randomisation inference.
inference.uncertainty: Percentile cluster bootstrap over init IDs, resampling all within-init treatments together.
inference.multiplicity: The completion-time DID is the sole primary test. Direct paired effects and secondary outcomes are labelled exploratory and reported with effect sizes and intervals.

implementation_manipulation_gate: All 80 integrity-valid receipts bind immutable raw artifacts and valid attempt provenance.
Every step reports the identically configured bypass candidate. Authority-on applies an eligible request; authority-off logs the shadow request but never bypasses the factual SMPC solve.
Authority-on applies each requested behavioural channel and its post-solver actual command equals the candidate.
Authority-off hash-audits factual reference, linearization, heading cost, action, desired speed, release/recovery state and next control history against their nominal values.
Authority-off shadow state is isolated; adaptive-risk allocation is the only permitted estimator-to-solver path.
Effective configs differ behaviourally only at yield_supervisor_behavioural_authority_mode.
All collision and other adverse scientific outcomes remain included.
Every scenario step exposes the common prospective wall-time columns and the raw samples exactly reconcile with the summary counts and quantiles.

observed_first_stage_activity.reporting: Report requested frequency and intensity separately for upstream reference, heading, forced-linearization and post-action channels by authority level, risk policy, target style and risk-by-style block.
observed_first_stage_activity.zero_activity_rule: Zero requested activity in any cell, block or the entire matrix is retained as a scientific outcome. It is not an integrity failure and cannot trigger rerunning, replacement or tuning.
observed_first_stage_activity.inactive_claim_limit: If the full matrix is inactive, report that authority assignment was implemented but no data identify masking conditional on an activated intervention; do not claim evidence for or against supervisor masking under activation.

stopping_rule: Stop after the 80 prespecified integrity-valid treatment keys have accepted raw receipts and the offline analysis receipt verifies. Scientific direction, p-values, collision incidence, intervention activity or apparent support never trigger extra or replacement rollouts.
claim_boundary: This identifies assignment to the complete application authority of the corrected reduced_intervention rule-aware supervisor within the frozen B1/estimator/risk/SMPC stack; it is not the historical full supervisor configuration. It does not identify deletion of prediction, adaptive risk, the interaction estimator, collision monitoring or SMPC constraints. Server wall-time results are platform-specific diagnostics rather than deployment or real-time guarantees.
